_about: Public-domain Boniface (Winfrid, c.675-754), the English apostle of the Germans, for the Word Hoard: The English Correspondence of Saint Boniface, translated and edited by Edward Kylie (King's Classics, 1911), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 37 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
